entities.name: Stenn
entities.description: Phyrexian sleeper agent appointed by Darien to lead the effort against the invasion.

entities.name: Argivia
entities.description: Realm whose downfall followed Stenn's appointment.

entities.name: Phyrexian sleeper agents
entities.description: Hidden Phyrexian infiltrators whose emergence troubled Darien.

events.summary: Darien, conflicted by the emergence of sleeper agents, wanted to withdraw behind walls, but Baird convinced him to face the threat.
events.quote: His loyal advisor Baird convinced him otherwise, and he steeled himself to face this threat head-on.

events.summary: Darien unwittingly appointed the sleeper agent Stenn to lead the effort, leading to the downfall of Argivia.
events.quote: He unwittingly appointed the Phyrexian sleeper agent Stenn to lead this effort, leading to the downfall of Argivia .
